verdict.rationale: Penpot's own docs describe a plugin system that lets developers create and publish their own custom extensions. They reference an open plugin API and a community marketplace of 113+ plugins, which supports the build-and-distribute part of the story. The evidence never mentions API reference documentation, TypeScript typings, or sample code. The older community comment wishing for a plugin system predates these docs and is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence of typings/type definitions, sample plugins or starter templates, detailed plugin API reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration of building and publishing a plugin.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented plugin API with typings and samples lets me build and distribute my own editor extensions

citations.quote: Our plugin system brings the flexibility that devs need to create and publish their own custom extensions.
Plugins (113+): Community plugin marketplace with accessibility, code, AI, and design system tools.
Use community plugins or build your own.
